name: harmonyhub
description: HarmonyHub - real-time music voting for parties

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,recommender -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:recommender --prefix backend"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
